The story uses a real-time, dramatic pacing where the story time and the reader's real-world time align almost perfectly. By framing the entire interaction between the moment the characters order their coffee and the moment the waitress delivers it (just a couple of minutes), the writer creates an intimate, tense atmosphere. Meanwhile, years of shared history and estrangement are effectively compressed into brief, subtext-heavy exchanges of dialogue. This balance between the immediate, unhurried present and the heavily compressed past makes the emotional weight of their reunion feel very natural and impactful.
